message.subject: Exploratory collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Unique Android homescreen launchers caught our attention as powerful tools for improving daily mobile productivity. EDXSO works with academic leaders on institutional growth, and we see huge value in adapting such customization tools for educators. We propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This would show educators how to streamline their devices for better classroom organization. We invite you to reply if a short call this month would suit you.
message.dm: We noticed your video on unique launchers. Could we discuss a sponsored walkthrough video to show teachers how to optimize their phone layouts?
